name: pumped_rank
description: Rank score of how likely Escherichia coli efflux pumps are to expel the compound. Calibrated against 50K compounds from the Ersilia reference library so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: effluxed_rank
description: Rank score of how likely the compound is to inhibit Escherichia coli growth only when TolC-dependent efflux is disabled. Calibrated against 50K compounds from the Ersilia reference library so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.
